title: File
description: Appends each record as a line to a file on disk, as CSV, JSON Lines or XML. Suited to feeding a downstream batch job or a reporting tool that reads a directory rather than an API. Each attached contract writes its own file, in its own format, with its own columns.

configFields.name: path
configFields.label: Output file
configFields.description: Where to write, as a path inside the adapter's container. Defaults to this deployment's configured output file, so two contracts that do not set it will share one file and interleave.

configFields.name: format
configFields.label: Format
configFields.description: csv writes a header and one comma-separated row per record. json writes JSON Lines -- one complete object per line, keeping numbers and booleans as themselves rather than as text. xml writes one <record> element per line; note that makes a fragment file rather than a whole document, since an append-only writer cannot close a root element.

configFields.name: columns
configFields.label: Columns
configFields.description: The columns to write, in order, e.g. [{"header": "first_name", "field": "firstName"}]. A list rather than an object because the order is part of the meaning and object key order is not preserved in storage. record_id is always written first and created_at always last, from the envelope -- do not list them.
